description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map' for rendering map-based plots within the PEAR PHP Image_Graph library. It handles loading map images and coordinate data, scaling, and plotting points on a map.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map
classes.description: A class for creating map plots with geographic points, handling map image loading, scaling, and point plotting.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Plotarea_Map
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map image and coordinate points from files.

methods.name: _fillLeft
methods.description: Returns the left boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillTop
methods.description: Returns the top boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillRight
methods.description: Returns the right boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _fillBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom boundary of the fill area.

methods.name: _setExtrema
methods.description: Placeholder for setting axis extrema, currently empty.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Calculates the pixel X position for a geographic coordinate.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Calculates the pixel Y position for a geographic coordinate.

methods.name: hideAxis
methods.description: Method to hide the axis, currently empty.

methods.name: addMappoint
methods.description: Adds a geographic point based on latitude and longitude.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a point with specified X and Y coordinates.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Calculates scaling and plot boundaries based on map and fill area sizes.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the map image and points onto the canvas.
